items.title: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy says new anti-drone weapon being tested
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: Zelenskyy said on Tuesday that Ukraine was carrying out tests on a new weapon to intercept drones and had recorded a successful hit overnight.

items.title: Germany sending fighter jets to Latvia to protect election from drone incidents
items.author: Linus Höller
items.summary: Germany will send four Eurofighter jets to defend Latvian airspace during upcoming elections, amid concerns over drone incursions from Russia and Belarus.

items.title: China warns US space weapons could fuel arms race
items.author: Eduardo Baptista, Reuters
items.summary: China urged the United States to halt its military build-up in outer space after Washington acknowledged it has weapons deployed in orbit.

items.author: Tom Kington
items.summary: Spain’s Indra has launched a low-cost cruise missile it claims will cost a tenth of top-of-the line current missiles, enabling swarm tactics.

items.title: India says China has scaled back troop numbers along their border
items.author: Anjana Pasricha
items.summary: Both countries had amassed tens of thousands of troops along their poorly demarcated Himalayan border following a deadly clash in 2020.

items.title: Japanese Global Hawk drone splashes down in crash
items.author: Gordon Arthur
items.summary: A Japanese Global Hawk drone nosedived into the Sea of Japan this week, instantly slashing the country’s fleet of these drones by a third.
